description: REQUIRES prior work24__auth__npki_session__login call with same account_link_id. Run the work24 (고용24) 사업주 사전진단 for one workplace across the measured subsidy programmes and return a verdict per programme (eligible / ineligible / undetermined - undetermined is never counted as eligible). Read-only. Path A atomic - the same call the subsidy_pack diagnosis leg makes. Files: a document generated from this result, as Excel (xlsx) only when requested in output_formats, listed in artifacts[] of the result with a download_url that works for 15 minutes; each file is kept for 7 days. If a link has expired, call xdata__job__result with the job_id from the result for fresh links.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

application_year.description: 신청연도 YYYY. Defaults to the current year.

business_management_no.description: 11-digit 고용보험 사업장관리번호. Omit to use the one saved at login.

output_formats.description: Optional. Also return this result as a file (Excel (xlsx)) in artifacts[] of the result. Omit it for data only.

programme_keys.description: Catalog programme keys (e.g. w24_b0010). Omit for every programme that has a 사전진단.
